name: Latis
source:
Type: Angel
Favorites: Anything beautiful
Dislikes: Demons
Hobby: Cleaning

Discipline is everything. A humorless angel who rarely smiles. But outside work, Latis is a dark angel with a sharp tongue. He protects you all the time from a demon or a reaper who try to gain your soul. It seems that he knows something about your past.

[Official in-game description]
